name: backdoor/create-role
description: Create an IAM role with administrator privileges and custom trust policy via EC2 user-data

options.name: TRUST_PRINCIPAL
options.description: Trusted principal ARN (e.g. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/name) or service (e.g. lambda.amazonaws.com)

options.name: ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name for the backdoor role (auto-generated if empty)

options.name: EXTERNAL_ID
options.description: External ID condition for the trust policy
